units.source_text: 她只觉得你俊俏无比，哪里会骂？”

en.t: She only thinks you are extraordinarily handsome; how could she possibly scold you?"

units.source_text: 亲王被他驳倒，垂头丧气而去。

en.t: The prince was refuted by him and went away dejected, with his head hanging low.

units.source_text: 柏木、红梅等也都受得赏赐，不甚丰厚，是妇女用的袍衫之类。

en.t: Kashiwagi, Kobai, and the others also received gifts, though they were not especially generous, consisting of robes and garments of the kind used by women.
